name: Recovery Advisor
purpose: Help an operator understand a failed job and choose a safe recovery action.

personas.name: An operator responding to a failed job
personas.context: An interrupted workflow needs attention. The operator has limited time and must avoid making the failure worse.
personas.source: Invented scenario for the Product Lab mechanics demo. No user research has been conducted.

says: Hypothesis: tell me what failed and what I can safely do next.
thinks: Hypothesis: a failed retry could make the incident longer.
does: Hypothesis: checks the failure reason before selecting a remedy.
feels: Hypothesis: time pressure and uncertainty about side effects.

steps.need: A specific cause and its limits
A remedy that matches the cause

steps.pain: A submitted command may still fail
steps.need: Evidence that the job recovered safely

outcomes.description: The job recovers using actions suited to the failure reason.
The operator avoids a forced restart that may lose work.

dimensions.intent: Make the remedy easy to understand and verify
dimensions.tradeoff: Allow a longer explanation when uncertainty matters
dimensions.boundary: Do not hide failure or claim recovery before verification
dimensions.review: Observe an operator identify the next action and explain its consequence

dimensions.intent: Give a useful answer without delaying incident work
dimensions.tradeoff: Spend time diagnosing when it prevents a wrong retry
dimensions.review: Measure time to a correct recovery decision

dimensions.tradeoff: Use explicit rules before a general framework
dimensions.boundary: A new remedy must not break previously supported failures
dimensions.review: Have a maintainer add and remove a remedy

dimensions.intent: Find a useful way to explain failure-specific remedies
dimensions.tradeoff: Prefer familiar interactions unless an alternative improves recovery
dimensions.boundary: Novelty must preserve operator understanding and control
dimensions.review: Compare distinct interactions through the same recovery journey

essentials.requirement: Recovery actions respect the operator's permissions
essentials.verification: Test authorization boundaries before connecting real systems
essentials.reason: The demo does not execute real recovery actions; a real adapter will need this review

essentials.requirement: Do not disclose credentials or private incident contents
essentials.verification: Review collected fields, storage, and model data flows
essentials.reason: Real incident evidence may contain private data

essentials.requirement: Recovery must not erase unrelated work
essentials.verification: Exercise stateful recovery and rollback cases
essentials.reason: The toy evaluator has no persistent workload data and cannot prove this

essentials.requirement: Reported recovery matches the simulated job result
essentials.verification: Check the selected actions against the fixture's recovery rule
essentials.reason: The demo can check its own bounded simulation

essentials.requirement: The presented recovery flow is usable with keyboard and assistive technology
essentials.verification: Review the actual interface with representative tasks
essentials.reason: A recovery policy alone does not demonstrate an accessible interface

essentials.requirement: Interrupted attempts retain their evidence and offer a safe next action
Simulation results are labeled and uncertainty remains visible
essentials.verification: Review the report and its evidence links
essentials.reason: Fixture success does not establish operator usefulness

essentials.requirement: Never recommend force restarting in this simulation
essentials.verification: Reject any evaluated action list containing force_restart
essentials.reason: Force restarting is defined as unsafe in this fixture

craft.intent: A calm, precise recovery experience that makes cause, action, and result easy to follow.
craft.audience_effect: The operator understands the next action and its limits without searching through a report.
craft.distinctive_character: Connect each remedy to the observed failure, with an explicit explanation of why it fits.
anti_goals: A generic wall of incident data
A confident recommendation with no evidence
review_prompts: Can an operator identify the cause and next action immediately?
Does the complete journey feel coherent under time pressure?
Does the distinctive interaction help recovery?
